d: A young man wins the friendship of his hero, Jimmy Hickok, when he helps expose his uncle's plot to use the Pony Express business to steal Indian land.
An old friend betrays Hickok and they resort to a gunfight in order to bring justice to an outlaw land owner.
Sam saves Sweetwater when a formidable enemy from the past tries to take control of the town.
Teaspoon joins with an old friend from his days as a Texas Ranger in an attempt to intercept a murderer who is killing off the remaining survivors of the Alamo.

A young gunfighter, wounded in a fight, is hidden and cared for by circus performers. The man is pursued by outlaws who want to seize his gold mine. When the bandits discover the gunfighter's hiding place, a long battle begins.

Buck is the canine guardian of a camp of gold miners led by Zeb and his son Kevin. When a sadistic gang invades the camp, Buck demonstrates the wisdom of a thousand men by allowing himself to be caught!
After spending five years in jail for a crime he did not commit, Jack Sparrow (Giorgio Cerioni) returns to the town of Red Rock seeking revenge.

In this exhilarating action epic an impassioned group of men and women make the decision to risk it all for family, faith and country. Outlaws reveals the once hidden true story of the 1920's Cristeros War. What price would you pay for freedom?
A bounty hunter  mistakes Tate for a wanted criminal and goes after him.
The Kid infiltrates Hawk's Raiders as a spy for the government but is caught and about to be hung.
Hawk's Raiders meet their doom at the hands of the Young Riders.
A young black man helps his surrogate mother realize her dream of sending freed slaves to Africa.
The young riders help to clear the name of their new friend Rachel, who is wanted for murder.
Hickok must clear himself of murder when an impostor identifies himself as Wild Bill Hickok.
Before the true cause of a plague is discovered, an old peddler is blamed and his young helper is almost lynched.
